- **Red‑orange clay court** — the only Grand Slam played on crushed brick ("terre battue").

- **Rows of red flowers (geraniums/petunias)** lining the balcony above the courts — the signature décor of the Stade Roland Garros in Paris.

<answer>The tournament is the French Open (Roland‑Garros) — identifiable by the red clay court, the FedEx/adidas courtside boards and the rows of red flowers along the stadium balcony, matching the audio's reference to the 2022 French Open semi‑final.
